turns.query: From SEC submissions metadata, identify Apple's non-amended Forms 10-Q for report dates 2025-03-29 and 2025-06-28. For the earlier six-month filing and the later nine-month filing, report the accession number and EDGAR acceptance timestamp. Explain the difference between a report date and an acceptance timestamp.

Using those two accessions, retrieve Apple's cumulative operating cash flow and payments to acquire property, plant and equipment from Company Facts, requiring the four facts to share the fiscal-year start date 2024-09-29. Report the six- and nine-month operating cash flow and capital expenditures as positive outflows in USD billions. Derive standalone third-quarter free cash flow as the nine-month minus six-month operating-cash-flow difference, less the corresponding capital-expenditure difference. Explain the derivation and the scope of the resulting measure.
